head_south.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: ONE isolated FRONT / south head texture of Vertin for a small RimWorld pawn.
INPUT 1 is the v7 head to EDIT. INPUT 2 is a common-native-scale comparison board: left column is v7; the next columns Texas and Zima are the EYE SIZE AND SHAPE references. Other columns are additional style examples. Do not reproduce the board or any other character.

PRIMARY EDIT: replace v7's narrow, slanted, realistic-looking half-lidded eyes and multiple eyelid folds with simple readable game-pawn eyes matching the Texas/Zima proportions in input 2.
Each eye should be taller and less slit-like, a compact rounded oval opening with a calm slightly flattened upper edge. Retain roughly the current eye spacing and horizontal width or make the width slightly narrower, but increase VISIBLE vertical opening about 65-80 percent so the height-to-width ratio approaches the references. At eventual 256px native head size, aim roughly 9-11px wide by 7-9px high for each visible whole eye, not giant baby eyes. Keep calm neutral character expression, not surprised.
Simple upper dark contour, restrained lower edge, one eyebrow per eye. REMOVE the duplicated stacked eyelid lines, long eyeliner wings, tiny lashes and eye-bag shading. A simple, clearly readable darker central pupil inside an upright grey-green iris; preserve the CURRENT muted grey-green / olive-grey IRIS COLOR, never change to blue, orange, yellow or vivid emerald. Iris only 2 broad color tones, at most one small pale pixel-like glint. No fine iris spokes, multi-faceted shiny reflections, gradients, or realistic eyeball modeling. Eye opening is taller, but do not draw huge circles, blank rectangular toy eyes, black dots only, or emotionless empty pupils.

NOSE AND MOUTH ARE APPROVED: retain input 1's existing small warm-grey nose wedge and small natural neutral lip line plus tiny lower-lip mark, at the same scale, color, shape and location. Do not erase, redesign, enlarge or move them. Keep the skin plane flat.
CHIN: very small correction only. Keep the cheek widths and gently tapering lower jaw; raise the very bottom chin tip about 1-2 native pixels, soften the tip into a short small rounded end. No long pointed V chin, but also no wide round U/bowl/baby face. Avoid shrinking the entire face or moving the nose/mouth.

IDENTITY AND LAYOUT LOCK: preserve head/hat/hair framing, dimensions, position and colors from input 1. Ash-silver grey-green swept hair, deep side part, long front lock at IMAGE LEFT, single low coiled bun also at IMAGE LEFT, plum hat and blue-grey bow/two dark-tipped ribbons at IMAGE RIGHT. Keep head upright facing straight FRONT; no rotation. Bold near-black outer contour consistent with the original. No added neck or body.
Finish: flat low-detail 2D game sprite, sparse coarse shapes; not a refined portrait, smooth glossy anime painting, or chunky 8-bit mosaic.
Output entire isolated head, real transparent alpha and padding, no background/checkerboard/text/panels/shadow.

head_east.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: ONE isolated RIGHT-facing true EAST PROFILE head texture for a small RimWorld pawn.
INPUT 1: current v7 east head, edit target; preserve its identity and approved nose/lips.
INPUT 2: newly edited v8 front head; match its simplified, taller eye opening and muted grey-green iris/pupil.
INPUT 3: same-native-scale comparison board. Texas and Zima SIDE eyes (bottom row, columns 2 and 3) are the proportional style reference.

Change the visible eye to match the v8 front and the local game-pawn examples. It must read as a simple compact upright eye, not v7's narrow realistic eyelid slit. Increase visible vertical opening by roughly 60-75 percent while keeping width close to the current width and keeping the same eye center/spacing relative to hair and nose. Final native target approximately 7-9px wide and 7-9px high, interpreted as visual guidance. Calm neutral gaze; no huge shocked baby eye. Use a clear darker central pupil within an upright oval muted grey-green/olive-grey iris matching input 2, two broad iris tones maximum and one small pale glint. Simple thicker dark upper lid and restrained side/lower edge. Remove stacked eyelid folds, long eyeliner wings, detailed iris reflections, lower-eye shading and fine lashes. Keep only one modest eyebrow. No glossy/realistic eye rendering, no tiny black-dot eye, no blank flat rectangle. Eye pupil/iris must remain readable after downsampling.

KEEP THE NOSE AND MOUTH from INPUT 1: existing nose bridge/tip silhouette and tiny warm nostril mark, natural short neutral mouth/lip line at the profile. Keep their shape/color/position; do not omit, flatten or redesign them.
CHIN: reduce only the very bottom projection slightly, about 1 native pixel, and round its tiny tip. Preserve a gently angled jaw and small chin, no long jutting pointed chin, no circular U-shaped face. Do not compress the entire face or move nose/mouth.

Preserve the upright RIGHT-facing true profile (not 3/4 and not tilted forward), original small ear and hair, ash-silver grey-green color, long front lock at IMAGE RIGHT, single low bun partly concealed at the rear IMAGE LEFT, plum hat and blue-grey bow/two dark-tipped ribbons at IMAGE LEFT. Keep the same overall head/hat dimensions, framing and position. Bold near-black outside contours. No additional neck/body.
Flat low-detail 2D game sprite, broad matte color shapes, not refined portrait shading or 8-bit mosaic. Entire isolated head, real transparent background and padding; no panels, text, checkerboard or cast shadow.

note: Eye dimension/percentage and chin offset in prompts are visual targets, not certified pixel measurements of generated anatomy.
